releases.name: v0.1.4 — Follow light/dark theme switching
releases.body:
Sidebar labels and values now stay readable when OpenCode switches between light and dark mode.

## Fixed
- Labels use `theme.text.base` and values use `theme.text.muted` instead of the terminal default foreground, so they no longer render as unreadable white text on light backgrounds.
- Added a `themeText()` fallback chain for the OpenCode 2.0.9 token renames (`text.default` → `text.base`, `text.subdued` → `text.muted`, no aliases kept).
- Colors are read inside JSX property expressions so babel-preset-solid wraps them in `_$effect` and they re-evaluate live.
- Subscribes to renderer `theme_mode` / `palette` events with delayed re-bumps (150ms / 600ms) because the host re-resolves color tokens asynchronously — the value read right at event time may still be stale.

## Changed
- Bump version to 0.1.4.

**Full diff**: https://github.com/youngxhui/opencode-sidebar-token-metrics/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4

releases.name: v0.1.3 — Live-refreshing sidebar metrics
releases.body:
### Fixed

- **Sidebar metrics no longer freeze at their first snapshot.** The plugin was compiled with `tsc`, whose React-style JSX transform evaluates expressions once at component creation, so the sidebar showed `-` and never updated. The build now precompiles with **babel-preset-solid** — the same transform the OpenCode host applies to its own TUI — so JSX compiles into reactive insert accessors and Speed / Cache / TTFT update live as the session runs.
- New windows now load the metrics block immediately instead of requiring a plugin panel reload (explicit `sync` on mount + refresh on 19 session events).

### Changed

- `tsc` is now **typecheck-only** (`noEmit`); `npm run build` uses the babel pipeline (`build.mjs`, `moduleName: @opentui/solid`, `generate: universal`).
- Removed diagnostic logging and debug rows.

---

### 修复

- **侧边栏指标不再冻结在首次快照**：此前用 `tsc` 编译，其 React 风格 JSX 转换会在组件创建时一次性求值表达式，导致三行指标永远显示 `-` 且不刷新。现改用与 OpenCode 宿主完全相同的 **babel-preset-solid** 预编译，JSX 编译为响应式 insert accessor，Speed / Cache / TTFT 随会话实时更新。
- 新窗口打开即加载指标块，不再需要重开 plugin 面板。

### 变更

- `tsc` 仅做类型检查（`noEmit`）；`npm run build` 使用 babel 管道（`build.mjs`）。
- 移除诊断日志与调试行。

---

**Install / 安装**

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-sidebar-token-metrics
```
